sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for 10285377 (catx.py, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: Peak season (Memorial Day weekend - Labor Day): $20 a night per single site, two vehicles included; $5 a night per extra vehicle; group sites #42 and #43 $50.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/lake-alva-campground (Fee Site and Info: 'Single Site: $20 per night (2 vehicles included per site)', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per night', 'Group Site (#42, #43): $50 per night'; page last updated August 24, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10285377/rates (2026-05-22 to 2026-09-07 Peak Season: PeakLakeAlvaStandardNonelectric 20), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10285377 (notice 'No utility hookups are avaliable'; all 39 catalog sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 39 individual RV/tent sites: 19 in Loop 1 (reservable in summer; catalog vehicle lengths 46-64 ft) and 20 first-come sites in Loop 2 (no catalog lengths), plus group sites #42 and #43. Each has a paved parking stall; vehicles that don't fit the spur pay $5 and park in the day-use area.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/lake-alva-campground ('19 individual RV/tent campsites within Loop 1', '20 campsites within Loop 2', 'a paved parking stall') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 10285377 (Max Vehicle Length 46-64 ft on the 19 reservable sites), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water from a hand pump, peak season only (rec.gov amenity 'Drinking Water (peak season)'). Campground hosts on site; swimming beach, concrete boat ramp and day-use area.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/lake-alva-campground ('Accessible vault toilets, drinking water and trash receptacles are available throughout the campground', 'Drinking water is available from a hand pump') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10285377 (amenities), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Loop 1 open year-round, snow load determining access (the road is not plowed); Loop 2 open only the Friday before Memorial Day through Labor Day; group sites closed 'due to hazardous conditions' (October 2026).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/lake-alva-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Loop 1: OPEN Year-Round : Snow Load Determines Accessibility', 'Loop 2: ... Open dates for this loop are the Friday before Memorial Day through Labor Day', 'Group Sites: CLOSED : Due to Hazardous Conditions') + rec.gov notice 'Access to the campground during winter is determined by snow level; road is not plowed', read 2026-10-22

values.note: Loop 1's 19 sites are reservable on recreation.gov from the Friday before Memorial Day to the Tuesday after Labor Day and first-come outside those dates; Loop 2's 20 sites are always first-come, paid on site by QR code in the Recreation.gov app. 16 consecutive nights, 32 nights a year. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m. Run by the Forest Service (Seeley Lake Ranger District).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/lake-alva-campground (Reservations, General Information) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10285377 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 16, maxStay 32 'Each Year'; check-in/out notice), read 2026-10-22

note: Lolo National Forest on the north shore of Lake Alva, ~11 mi north of Seeley Lake off MT-83 (larger main campground, distinct from the small Lakeside CG at the north end). Swimming beach, boat ramp and day-use area; no-wake lake with nesting loons. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov: confirmed $20 (2026), no hookups, 39 sites to 64 ft (catalog), vault toilets and potable water, reservable on rec.gov with some FCFS sites.
